Un bambino cammina e lascia tre impronte.

enAudit: habitats G1-398 base instruction is TWO sentences ("Look at the habitats. Under each animal, write...") and G2-381 report is THREE; the brief asks one child-level sentence. it merges each into one.
habitats tileLabel.polar "Polar Ice" is the plaque of an ANTARCTIC-only page (the penguin page) while its sibling says "Arctic": name the place. it uses Antartide / Artico.

story-sequencing G1-400 instruction "circle the picture in the box that comes next": "the box" reads as the dashed ? box, which holds nothing to circle; the choices sit in the row below. it: "cerchia, tra quelle qui sotto, la vignetta che viene dopo".
cursive-writing G3-401 instruction is two sentences in the wrong order: the page asks to trace the grey sentence first, the text says it last. it puts the trace first in one sentence.

sink-or-float G2-382 instruction "Color where each clay shape ends up" never names the ring the child actually colours, while the base names it; it says "Colora un cerchio per mostrare dove finisce...".
sink-or-float G1-408 title capitalises "With" against the other title-case rules and wraps to three lines; heavy for a G1 page.
story-sequencing sandwich: "First, there are two slices of bread" then "the sandwich is cut in half" names a sandwich that no picture shows as one; it keeps bread (pane) throughout.
healthy-habits G1-405: the EN weekday head starts on Sunday; the page must follow each locale calendar (it renders lun..dom correctly from data/b2/calendar.js).

cursive-writing: it-moderna (vendored) renders stampato capitals and unlooped joined print (opened: S L G F A print, e unlooped); Italian scuola primaria corsivo loops b/f/l/e and teaches cursive capitals, so it ships it-trad (ruling below).
cursive-writing it-trad z is drawn print-like (no descender loop as in many Italian quaderni); acceptable, no Italian word on the pinned list depends on it except tazza.
cursive-writing G3-401 render: word spacing in the grey model is tight ("dorme sul" nearly touches in it-trad); a font/spacing matter for the build, not a string.

cursive-writing G2-384 capitals: KEPT in it. Corsivo maiuscolo is taught in classe seconda (harvest: "corsivo maiuscolo scuola primaria", "s/t corsivo maiuscolo scuola primaria", "alfabeto corsivo maiuscolo" x20+); schools that keep stampato maiuscolo are a minority practice, and it-trad draws the school capitals (opened S L G F A).
